messages.author: 4317e7b9c140bf2d
messages.subject: tabsetPanel class in v14.1
parts:
I upgraded my version of shiny from 13 something to 14.1 yesterday and the following code fragment stopped working:

tabsetPanel(id="main_menu", class="navbar-inverse",

The error is:

Error in build(tabs, ulClass, textFilter, id) : 
  Tabs should all be unnamed arguments, but some are named: class

Is there an alternative way to set a css class on a tabsetPanel? This is a standard Bootswatch class.

Tom
